events.headline: Blake Corum runs 32 times for 184 yards and a touchdown as the Rams beat Green Bay 26-13; Kyren Williams held to 12 carries
events.detail: Corum set a career high with 184 rushing yards and a score on 32 carries in Wednesday night's win at SoFi Stadium, the most by a Rams player in a game since Todd Gurley in 2018, per the team's recap. Kyren Williams added 46 yards on 12 carries. The Rams are 7-4 and have won five straight. Separately, Tom Pelissero reported Wednesday that Williams has played through turf toe for about a month, per Yahoo Sports.
events.so_what: A 32-to-12 carry split plus a month of turf toe for Williams makes this a real shift while the toe lingers: Corum is a FLEX start and the priority add wherever he is available, and Williams drops to a FLEX rather than a locked RB2 until the carries come back. Corum catches less, so his weeks ride on carries and touchdowns.

source.label: Los Angeles Rams: Game recap, Corum's 184 rushing yards lift Rams over Packers (Nov. 25)

events.headline: Christian Watson (concussion) leaves the loss at the Rams; Jordan Love throws two interceptions
events.detail: Watson left late in the second quarter with a concussion after a hit that got Rams safety Kamren Kinchens ejected, per Yahoo's live coverage. Love finished 17 of 29 for 198 yards, a touchdown and two interceptions, and Green Bay ran only 14 times for 55 yards without Josh Jacobs, per Yahoo. The Packers have a long gap before Week 13.
events.so_what: A concussion puts Watson in the protocol with no timeline, so plan Week 13 without him until he clears; the extra days before Green Bay's next game help. Love's two interceptions cost only a point each here, but a 198-yard night with one touchdown is a streaming floor, not a start. The 14-carry run game is a red flag for whoever carries the ball while Jacobs is out.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: Rams ride Blake Corum to Thanksgiving Eve win; Love throws 2 INTs with Watson out (Nov. 25)

events.headline: Brock Purdy (low ankle) did not practice Wednesday; Kyle Shanahan calls him day to day before Sunday at Seattle
events.detail: Purdy sat out Wednesday's practice with a low ankle sprain, and Shanahan described him as day to day ahead of Sunday's game against the Seahawks, per NFL.com's roundup. Seattle's Sam Darnold (quad, ribs) is expected to start the same game if his Wednesday practice goes well.
events.so_what: Day to day after a DNP is a forecast, not a clearance. Line up a streamer before Friday's designation, because a low ankle can sap the scrambling that adds rushing points even if he plays. 49ers pass catchers carry more risk with a backup or a hobbled Purdy.

source.label: NFL.com: News roundup, Purdy day to day (Nov. 25)

events.headline: Romeo Doubs designated to return from injured reserve by New England
events.detail: The Patriots opened Doubs' 21-day practice window on Wednesday, per NFL.com's roundup. New England starts Tommy DeVito at the Chargers in Week 12 with Drake Maye out.
events.so_what: A designation is a practice window, not an activation, so he is a bench stash until New England moves him to the active roster. With DeVito at quarterback, even a returning Doubs is a FLEX at best.

source.label: NFL.com: News roundup, Patriots designate Romeo Doubs to return (Nov. 25)

events.headline: Steelers release Aaron Rodgers; Mason Rudolph starts Friday vs. Denver
events.detail: Pittsburgh officially released Rodgers on Wednesday, per the NFL transactions wire as reported in Yahoo's live NFL feed, a day after announcing that Rudolph will start Friday's Week 12 game against the Broncos. On Monday Mike McCarthy had said "Aaron Rodgers is our quarterback" after the 19-16 loss to the Eagles. Michael Pittman Jr. (foot), still on injured reserve in his 21-day practice window, was a full participant Tuesday and is expected to be activated for Friday, per NFL.com.
events.so_what: Rodgers is a drop: a release means no Steelers role at all, and any new team would need weeks before he matters. Rudolph is not a streamer against a Denver defense on a short week. Steelers pass catchers keep their roles but lose some efficiency. Pittman is a bench hold until the activation is official, then a FLEX at most in a crowded receiver room. The game is Friday, so decide before the usual Sunday window.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: NFL news live updates, Steelers release Aaron Rodgers (Nov. 25)

events.headline: Kenneth Walker III (groin) ruled out for Thanksgiving at Buffalo after a Wednesday DNP
events.detail: Walker was limited Monday and Tuesday, then did not practice Wednesday and was ruled out for Thursday's game against the Bills, his third straight missed game, per NFL.com. TE Noah Gray (rib) is questionable after full practices. Emmett Johnson has led the backfield in Walker's absence, per CBS Sports.
events.so_what: Out is settled: bench Walker for the Thursday game and do not burn a waiver claim to replace him for a single week if he is otherwise a starter. Emmett Johnson is the volume back again in a game that locks Thursday. Two limited practices before the setback suggest he is close, so hold Walker for Week 13.

source.label: NFL.com: News roundup, Kenneth Walker III to miss Thanksgiving game (Nov. 25)

events.headline: Brandon Aiyuk signs with Washington's practice squad after clearing waivers
events.detail: San Francisco waived Aiyuk on Monday and he cleared waivers Tuesday. After visiting the Commanders on Wednesday, agent Drew Rosenhaus told ESPN that Aiyuk will sign to Washington's practice squad, per NFL.com's roundup. He has not played since tearing his ACL and MCL in October 2024.
events.so_what: A practice-squad deal is the clearest sign yet that he is weeks from a real role, not days. He is a deep bench stash at most where you have room to wait: Washington is a target-hungry offense with Terry McLaurin hurt, but he needs an elevation and a snap count before he belongs near a lineup.

source.label: NFL.com: News roundup, Aiyuk to sign to Commanders practice squad (Nov. 25)

events.headline: Josh Jacobs (finger) ruled out for Wednesday's game at the Rams, his second straight absence
events.detail: Green Bay ruled out Jacobs, who fractured his right ring finger in Week 9 and had surgery, for Wednesday night in Los Angeles, his second straight missed game, per CBS Sports. Kaleb Johnson has 24 carries over the last two games with Jacobs out, per RotoWire (Nov. 23). Micah Parsons was cleared to make his season debut in the same game.
events.so_what: Settled for this week: Jacobs is out and Kaleb Johnson is a volume start in a Wednesday game, so set it before kickoff tonight. The limited practices this week point to a return after the long gap to Week 13, so hold Jacobs.

source.label: CBS Sports: NFL Thanksgiving injury report, Jacobs out (Nov. 25)

events.headline: Ted Hurst III scores twice as his snap share climbs to 64%, the Buccaneers saying they plan to feature him more
events.detail: Hurst caught 5 of 7 targets for 56 yards and two touchdowns at Detroit on a 64% snap share, his highest since Week 3, and the coach said the team plans to feature him more, per Yahoo's waiver column. He ranked third among Tampa Bay receivers in snaps and routes behind Chris Godwin, per FantasyPros. Jalen McMillan (knee), who had been out, was designated to return from injured reserve on Wednesday, per NFL.com, which threatens the extra snaps.
events.so_what: One two-touchdown game on seven targets is a boom week, not a role yet, and McMillan opening his practice window could take back the snaps that produced it. He is a bench add with upside where you have the spot, and a FLEX only once his target count matches the snap share.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: Week 12 fantasy football waiver wire (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Saquon Barkley cleared: full practice Wednesday and no designation for Thanksgiving at Dallas
events.detail: Barkley left Sunday's win over Pittsburgh in the fourth quarter with a left arm or shoulder injury and was estimated limited Monday. He practiced in full Wednesday and carries no designation for Thursday, per the Eagles' final injury report; Philadelphia's only players ruled out are Arnold Ebiketie and Jonathan Jones. Barkley has said he does not expect to be 100% again this season. Will Shipley (foot, illness) was limited.
events.so_what: Start him: no designation means the decision is made, and his touch share drives his value. Shipley stays a handcuff hold only.

source.label: Philadelphia Eagles: Eagles at Cowboys injury report, Week 12 (Nov. 25)

events.headline: Thanksgiving tight ends: Jake Ferguson ruled out; Dalton Kincaid questionable; Sam LaPorta and Dallas Goedert full Wednesday
events.detail: Dallas ruled out Ferguson (knee, ankle) for Thursday against Philadelphia after he did not practice all week, along with WR Jonathan Mingo, per NFL.com. Buffalo listed Kincaid (thumb, ankle) as questionable after limited work. Detroit had LaPorta (ankle) full and Philadelphia had Goedert (shin) full on Wednesday, per NFL.com and the Eagles' report.
events.so_what: Ferguson is out, so start a streamer at tight end before Thursday's lock. Kincaid is a game-time call in a late Thursday game; with no fallback once he is inactive, start him only if your alternative is weak. LaPorta and Goedert are normal starts.

source.label: NFL.com: News roundup, Wednesday Nov. 25 injury reports

events.headline: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle, foot) did not practice Wednesday; Week 12 status unresolved
events.detail: Tuten limped off late in the loss to the Giants after being stepped on twice, on top of ongoing foot and ankle trouble, and played only 43% of the snaps. Liam Coen had said the recheck was not too bad and that he expected Tuten to be limited this week, but Tuten did not practice Wednesday, per NFL.com. Chris Rodriguez Jr. would lead the backfield if Tuten sits; he has not topped 11 carries in a game this season, per FantasyPros.
events.so_what: A DNP after the coach forecast limited work is a step backward, so plan around Tuten missing Sunday. Rodriguez is the add at running back: a likely starter if Tuten sits, with Jacksonville a big home favorite. Hold Tuten through Friday's designation.

source.label: NFL.com: News roundup, Tuten DNP Wednesday (Nov. 25)

events.headline: Justin Herbert (concussion) held out of Wednesday practice; DJ Uiagalelei the only other QB on the roster
events.detail: Herbert entered the concussion protocol after the 27-24 loss to the Jets and did not practice Wednesday, per Jim Harbaugh via NFL.com. DJ Uiagalelei is the only other quarterback on the active roster, with Jake Browning on the practice squad. The Chargers host New England in Week 12. Keaton Mitchell also left the Jets game with knee and back injuries, which puts Kimani Vidal in line for more work, per RotoWire (Nov. 23).
events.so_what: No practice and no protocol timeline: plan Week 12 without Herbert and pick up a streamer now. His 4-point-pass-TD plus rushing profile is hard to replace, which is why holding him past this week is reasonable where you have bench room. Chargers pass catchers drop to FLEX risk with Uiagalelei, and Vidal is a desperation back only.

source.label: NFL.com: News roundup, Herbert will not practice Wednesday (Nov. 25)

events.headline: Roschon Johnson (ankle) ruled out for Thursday at Detroit
events.detail: Johnson got hurt in the first quarter of the 21-13 win over the Saints yet still ran for 103 yards, per UPI. He did not practice all week and was ruled out for the Thanksgiving game at Detroit, per NFL.com. CBS Sports lists him third on the depth chart behind D'Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai, who is playing through turf toe; Chicago elevated RB Salvon Ahmed from the practice squad.
events.so_what: Bench Johnson for Thursday. Swift and Monangai split the work in a Thursday game that locks early, and Monangai's turf toe makes Swift the safer FLEX of the two.

source.label: NFL.com: News roundup, Roschon Johnson ruled out (Nov. 25)

events.headline: J.K. Dobbins suspended for Friday's game at Pittsburgh for conduct detrimental; Jonah Coleman in line to start, Tyler Badie designated to return
events.detail: Sean Payton announced a one-game team suspension for "conduct detrimental to the team" and did not elaborate. NFL.com places it on Friday's Week 12 game at the Steelers and notes Dobbins played one snap in the Week 11 win over Las Vegas. Dobbins has 324 rushing yards and three touchdowns on 99 carries, per Yahoo, which expects rookie Jonah Coleman (302 rushing yards in six games) to start. Tyler Badie (thumb) was designated to return from injured reserve and was a full participant in the practice estimation, per NFL.com.
events.so_what: Dobbins is a zero for Week 12: bench him, and do not drop him for a one-game team suspension. Coleman becomes a volume FLEX for the week with the early-down and goal-line work in his hands. Badie returning adds a passing-down body that can trim Coleman's snaps, so Coleman is a FLEX rather than a locked RB2. The game is Friday, so lineups lock earlier than usual.

source.label: NFL.com: News roundup, Kenneth Walker III returns to practice; Broncos suspend J.K. Dobbins (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Sam Darnold (quad) in line to start Sunday vs. the 49ers after missing two games; Macdonald wants to see Wednesday first
events.detail: Seattle plans to start Darnold against San Francisco, per Yahoo's live NFL feed, but Mike Macdonald said "before we make any declarations for Sam, we'll get through Wednesday." Darnold has missed two games with the quad injury suffered in Week 8.
events.so_what: A planned start is still a forecast until he practices. If he plays, Seahawks pass catchers get their starting quarterback back, which is a clear upgrade over the fill-in. Darnold himself offers no rushing floor, so he is a matchup streamer at best.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: NFL news live updates, Darnold expected to start (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Antonio Williams posts 9-122 on 11 targets vs. Cincinnati, his fourth productive game in five since Terry McLaurin's injury
events.detail: Williams caught 9 of 11 targets for 122 yards in the Monday night win over the Bengals, including a 42-yard catch-and-run that set up the winning field goal, per FantasyPros. He has 50-plus yards or a touchdown in four of five games since McLaurin was hurt, per Yahoo's waiver column. Washington plays at Arizona in Week 12.
events.so_what: This is a real target role, not a one-game spike: 11 targets is a WR1 workload in this offense while McLaurin is out. He is a FLEX start at Arizona and a priority add. His value drops back to bench depth whenever McLaurin returns, so it is a rental, and Aiyuk landing in Washington would also cut into it.

source.label: FantasyPros: Waiver wire advice, players to add, stash and drop for Week 12 (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Dylan Sampson has out-snapped Quinshon Judkins three games running in a Browns backfield now split down the middle
events.detail: Sampson has 77, 69, 48 and 37 scrimmage yards in four games since returning from a knee injury and has out-snapped Judkins in three straight, a 50-50 split, per Yahoo's waiver column. He has at least three catches in all four games, per FantasyPros. Cleveland hosts Las Vegas in Week 12, with Deshaun Watson coming off three straight 300-yard passing games.
events.so_what: Judkins can no longer be treated as a locked RB2: the snaps are even, and Sampson owns the passing-down work, which keeps his floor steady even on days the carries split. Sampson is a FLEX add. Judkins drops to a FLEX who needs a touchdown to return value.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: Week 12 fantasy football waiver wire (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Caleb Douglas commands a 30.3% target share in Miami's second game without Malik Willis
events.detail: With Willis on IR, Douglas has 3-71 on 8 targets against Indianapolis and 2-30 on 10 targets with Kyle McCord at quarterback, per FantasyPros, which put his Week 11 target share at 30.3% despite a couple of drops. He has eight or more targets in each of the last three games, per Yahoo. Miami hosts the Jets in Week 12.
events.so_what: The targets are real and the quarterback is the cap: a first-time starter limits his yardage and touchdown ceiling. He is a volume FLEX in a pinch and a bench hold otherwise, with his value rising as soon as Willis returns.

source.label: FantasyPros: Waiver wire advice for Week 12 (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Woody Marks (concussion) trending in the right direction, DeMeco Ryans says, but not yet cleared for Week 12
events.detail: Marks is recovering from a concussion and Ryans said he is trending in the right direction and hopes he is available for Week 12, per The Big Lead via Yahoo Sports. No clearance from the protocol has been reported.
events.so_what: Hopeful is not cleared. Keep him on the bench until the protocol clearance is reported, and have a Sunday alternative ready, since concussion returns can stall on the last step.

source.label: The Big Lead via Yahoo Sports: 7 major NFL injury updates entering Week 12 (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Daniel Jones clears waivers after his Colts release; Anthony Richardson takes over as Indianapolis starter
events.detail: Indianapolis released Jones on Friday and he cleared waivers Monday afternoon, making him a free agent the Colts will keep paying, per NBC Sports/PFT. Anthony Richardson is expected to start, with Riley Leonard as his backup, per RotoWire's waiver column. Reports name Arizona as a possible landing spot for Jones; New England and Cleveland were reported as not interested.
events.so_what: Richardson is the most interesting quarterback on most wires because of the konami rushing premium: his legs give him a floor that pocket streamers lack, though his accuracy keeps it volatile. Jones is a drop until he signs somewhere with a path to starts. Colts pass catchers, Tyler Warren first, take on more variance with Richardson throwing.

source.label: NBC Sports/PFT: Daniel Jones clears waivers, becomes free agent (Nov. 23)

events.headline: Puka Nacua out for the season after knee surgery; Terrance Ferguson also done with ankle surgery, leaving Tyler Higbee as the lead tight end
events.detail: The Rams ruled Nacua out for the rest of 2026 after surgery on the knee he hurt Nov. 8 against Washington, per SI's Rams coverage. On Nov. 23 Sean McVay said Ferguson will stay on injured reserve for the season because his ankle needs surgery; rehab of an earlier hamstring injury slowed the ankle's recovery. Higbee, Colby Parkinson, Davis Allen and rookie Max Klare are the remaining tight ends. Davante Adams (hamstring) is expected back no earlier than Week 13, per FantasyPros, and Konata Mumpfield led Rams receivers with a 64% snap share before the Week 11 bye.
events.so_what: Nacua is a drop now that the IR stash has no return date, unless your IR slot has nothing better to hold. Higbee is a streaming tight end with the clearest path to targets in this offense. Mumpfield is a bench piece until Adams returns, and Adams himself becomes the first read whenever he is activated.

source.label: SI Ram Digest: Rams lose Terrance Ferguson for season as injury situation continues to spiral (Nov. 23)

events.headline: Tommy DeVito named Patriots starter for Week 12 at the Chargers with Drake Maye (right ankle) out indefinitely
events.detail: Maye was hurt on the first drive of the Week 10 loss to Detroit in Munich; the Patriots fear a fractured right ankle and Mike Vrabel said he likely will not be available coming out of the bye, per the Boston Globe (Nov. 16). Adam Schefter called him out indefinitely, if not for the season. DeVito went 12-of-24 for 81 yards, a touchdown and an interception in relief and is the Week 12 starter, per Yahoo's live NFL feed (Nov. 24). A.J. Brown (hamstring) is also out, which leaves Demario Douglas as the most-targeted healthy receiver, per CBS Sports.
events.so_what: Maye goes to IR where your slot allows, or the wire if it does not; there is no return date to plan around. DeVito is not a streamer and every Patriots pass catcher takes a downgrade. Douglas is a target-volume FLEX only in a pinch.

source.label: Boston Globe: Drake Maye injury update (Nov. 16)

events.headline: Derrick Henry cleared the concussion protocol after Sunday's evaluation; Jacoby Brissett starts again with Lamar Jackson on IR
events.detail: Henry was evaluated for a concussion in the fourth quarter of the 35-33 loss at Carolina after 111 scrimmage yards and a touchdown on 17 touches, per UPI, and has since cleared the protocol, per Yahoo's waiver column (Nov. 24). Justice Hill had 6 carries for 69 yards and a touchdown plus 4 catches in the same game. Brissett, acquired in a deadline trade with Arizona, has thrown 49 and 37 passes in his two Baltimore starts, per FantasyPros. Lamar Jackson had surgery on his right thumb and Jesse Minter said the injury typically needs six to 10 weeks to heal, per AP via NY1 (Nov. 13).
events.so_what: Henry is a normal start at Houston: lock him back into the lineup. Hill's role is tied to Brissett's pass volume, not to Henry missing time, so he is a FLEX only in deeper formats and his Week 11 line came on just 10 touches. Jackson stays on IR, and his late-season return is not something to plan a playoff lineup around.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: Week 12 fantasy football waiver wire, Chris Rodriguez Jr. and Dylan Sampson among top pickups (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Brock Bowers (ankle, quad) missed Week 11 at Denver; Fernando Mendoza threw three touchdowns without him
events.detail: Bowers was out against the Broncos with ankle and quad injuries that have lingered since he left the Seattle game, per ESPN's Week 11 takeaways. Mendoza threw for 267 yards and three touchdowns with 22 rushing yards in the game, and Jack Bech caught 8 of 9 targets for 88 yards and a score, per Yahoo's waiver column. Las Vegas plays at Cleveland in Week 12 and then has its bye.
events.so_what: Bowers is a hold, not a drop: the ankle has no structural damage reported, but with a Week 13 bye coming the team has a reason to sit him one more week, so have a tight end streamer ready. Mendoza's line was a real ceiling game, three 4-point passing scores plus some rushing, and he is a legitimate streamer at Cleveland. Bech is a one-game spike tied to Bowers' absence.

source.label: ESPN: NFL Week 11 big takeaways, questions and fantasy spin (Nov. 23)
